root: ^An easy victory. But still, one thing bothers me…
^Either this is a trap, or I am really smarter than the gods. After all, I just beat Athena herself! You can drop the act—I know who you are.
^Ha, so observant… and more cheeky than I expected.
^Hard to believe, though… The goddess of wisdom, here, in this hole? I always thought you gods couldn’t care less about mortals. Honestly, I still don’t get why my people worship you.
^Watch your tongue in my presence. But fine—no punishment today. Instead I have a proposal for you.

^Once a year, we have a grand tournament in Diodós on Olympus. Every god chooses a champion. Mostly these are strong monsters or heroes who have already proven themselves to the gods. The winner earns the right to stand before Zeus and the entire pantheon… to ask for one wish. Anything what they want.
^So you’re suggesting… that I'll fight for you?
^Not so hard to guess, is it?
^Hm. And what do I gain from this? Treasure? Wine for my whole life? Don’t make me laugh—gods never keep their promises.
^Who said that your wish has to be material? You could ask for anything… or nothing. Just win, and prove that mortals are wiser than we think. Isn’t that what you crave? Proof of your words.
^So, you want to use my ambition…
^And you want to use mine. Equal benefit—you get your chance to speak to the gods as a winner, and I get my fighter. And perhaps… you’ll bruise a few divine egos.
^(smirks) Alright. Let’s say your offer is tempting. But why should I trust a goddess who admits she’s so easy to beat?
^(narrowing her eyes coldly) Careful, mortal. My patience is not endless.
^We do. But don’t think you’ll march straight into the games. First comes training. I won’t let my fighter get thrown out in the very first round.
^Oh, worried about my honor? I’m touched.
^Don’t flatter yourself. I’m worried about my own reputation.
^Gods are really selfish. What if I lose even after that "trainings"?

^As if you’re any different. As I say you hate those who resemble you the most. Anyway answering to your question about losing, don't worry, I have some special trick in my pocket. So after your lose I'll just return everything back. Okay we’re done talking. Meet me in the forest temple. No more idling, time to work, little fishy.
